title: Professional 2026-09-20 — Dual storage heating with fixed-temperature circuits
goal: Represent a boiler, 600 L buffer, 200 L domestic-water storage, dedicated charging pumps, check valves and two fixed-temperature heating distributors.

rubric.must: The two storage vessels and their separate charging and return paths are complete and separately identifiable.
Control signal types agree with their declared actuator types; contradictory capillary and pneumatic assignments are not accepted.
Pump, valve, vessel and pipe-service labels remain readable without hiding connections.

provenance.notes: Selected against a real first user request. Source defects are intentionally preserved. Project identity is removed; no customer IDs or private prompt text are included. These are evaluation inputs, not approved professional reference designs. Full conversation changes and domain behavior require separate review.
